doc.title: Line Shutdown and Shift Handover
doc.file: SOP-102 Line Shutdown and Shift Handover.pdf
doc.purpose: Leave the line clean, safe and documented for the next shift.

roles.name: Line Lead
roles.does: Writes the handover and meets the incoming Line Lead.

parameters.quote: Enter every stop of 3 minutes or longer in FRM-PR-09 Downtime Log Sheet with the cause and a short comment.

parameters.what: stop length that requires a full start-up
parameters.quote: If the line will be down for more than 60 minutes, the next start follows SOP-101 in full.

rules.topic: who moves held product to the hold cage
rules.statement: The Operator moves any product on hold to the hold cage at shutdown.
rules.quote: Move any product on hold to the hold cage as described in QP-315.

unsure.what: Cleaning filler nozzles, the drip tray and the case packer reject bin (step 2) does not mention lockout
unsure.why: SP-402 scope covers cleaning that puts any part of the body inside a guard; SOP-102 does not reference SP-402
